Rosé (Roseanne Park / Park Chae-young) is a South Korean-New Zealand singer and global pop sensation, best known as the main vocalist and lead dancer of BLACKPINK. Renowned for her distinctively airy, soulful vocal timbre and emotional delivery, she has carved out a unique musical identity both within her group and as a standalone soloist. Following her solo debut with the record-breaking single album R (featuring hits like "On the Ground" and "Gone"), she expanded her artistic range with her full-length debut studio album, rosie. Fueled by chart-topping releases—including the massive global sensation "APT." featuring Bruno Mars as well as fan-favorite tracks like "Toxic Till the End", "Number One Girl", and "3am"—Rosé has cemented her status as an auteur who bridges raw vulnerability with modern pop-punk and alternative pop sensibilities. Beyond her musical achievements, her signature effortless elegance and artistic vision have made her an iconic force in fashion and global culture.
